name: TOB Notification Send Log
description: Pure bookkeeping for the notification engine's own frequency/dedup checks (max per day, min gap, 'already sent this exact event today') — one row per successful send. Not user-facing; the user-facing record is the existing Notification Log doctype. System-Manager-only. `channel` (added for the Communication Center, Decision 14) makes this the one shared send-history table across Push/Email/WhatsApp rather than three separate counters — existing rows default to PUSH via this field's own DB-level default, since every row before this addition was a push send. The Communication Center keys its own idempotency check on (event_code=campaign_id, user, channel) against this same table, reusing it rather than adding a parallel one.

fields.label: Event Code
fields.description: An automated-engine event_code, OR (for a Communication Center channel-send row) the campaign's own name — reused as the correlating key rather than adding a separate `campaign` link field, per this doctype's 'additive only' extension.

fields.label: Tracked
fields.description: 1 when this send carried a send_id in its push payload, so the app can report received/tapped back against it. Older rows are untracked and excluded from open-rate math.

fields.label: Devices Reached
fields.description: Devices Google's push service accepted the message for (HTTP 200) — accepted for delivery, not proof the phone displayed it.
